name: Agnost AI
long_description:
Agnost AI monitors AI agents in production: chat agents, voice agents, copilots and MCP servers.

It reads every conversation and OpenTelemetry trace, groups them by user and session, and catches what dashboards miss: wrong answers that look like success, frustrated users, broken tool calls.

Teams write evals/checks in plain language; Agnost judges every production conversation and alerts in Slack. When something fails, Auto Improve opens a pull request with a fix tested against past runs. Works with all agents framework.

For high-volume workflows, we also fine-tune specialized models on a customer's own traces.
one_liner: We find where AI agents fail, then train better models to run them
